title: Rainbow with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rainbow arcs -->
  <path d="M10 78 A40 40 0 0 1 90 78" fill="none" stroke="#ff4d4d" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M18 78 A32 32 0 0 1 82 78" fill="none" stroke="#ff9f2e" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M26 78 A24 24 0 0 1 74 78" fill="none" stroke="#ffe14d" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M34 78 A16 16 0 0 1 66 78" fill="none" stroke="#5ddc6b" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M42 78 A8 8 0 0 1 58 78" fill="none" stroke="#4db8ff" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- smiling face on the blue/center band -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="70" r="2.6" fill="#0a0f1e"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="70" r="2.6" fill="#0a0f1e"/>
  <path d="M43 74 Q50 80 57 74" fill="none" stroke="#0a0f1e" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little cloud puffs at the base -->
  <circle cx="14" cy="82" r="7" fill="#eef4ff"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="84" r="8" fill="#eef4ff"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="84" r="8" fill="#eef4ff"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="82" r="7" fill="#eef4ff"/>
</svg>
